reuse.why: All six link handlers share the new guards and Fintegra reuses bank lookup and sync helpers, but replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's local cleanup.

duplication.why: The change adds copies of the provider linking lifecycle, transaction download plumbing, and local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration, and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested linking and provider changes and their supporting types and tests.

maintainability.why: Shared guards centralize the linking rules, but duplicated workflows and a validation-named helper that also unlinks accounts increase maintenance burden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked reproduces unlinkAccount's local cleanup instead of extracting that cleanup for both paths; avoiding provider removal is appropriate, but the duplicated state transition remains.

disguised_duplication.where: app.ts: linkFintegraAccount reshapes the existing provider linking lifecycle; sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces SimpleFin's single-account request, error handling, and response normalization with batch handling removed.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: the replacement step adds replaceExistingLink and its conditional branch to ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, expanding a shared validation helper into an account-mutating operation; all six link handlers still use the shared guards.
